brief: Trial NCT01010373 (BioMAS). What is its status and stated reason? Put the trial in context with snapshot base rates.

findings.claim: Trial NCT01010373 has an overall status of SUSPENDED.
findings.notes: Confirmed via snapshot and live record.

findings.claim: Trial NCT01010373 has the stated why_stopped text: "The sponsor is currently focusing on different indications", categorized as business/strategic.
Trial NCT01010373 start date is January 2015, primary completion date is January 2016, and completion date is January 2016.
Trial NCT01010373 results are not posted on ClinicalTrials.gov. Results due date was December 31, 2016, and it is 3,596 days late.
Across the snapshot, business/strategic is the most common stop category, accounting for 1,485 out of 3,739 stopped trials (39.7%).
